## Type of Change

## AI/Tooling Disclosure

Please disclose if AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.) were used in creating this PR:

- [ ] AI tools were used to assist with this contribution
- [ ] If yes, please describe how: (e.g., code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation)

**Note**: Using AI tools is acceptable and encouraged, but all AI-generated code must be:
- Human-reviewed and understood by the contributor
- Tested and validated
- Free of hardcoded secrets or security vulnerabilities
- Compliant with repository licenses and standards

If AI tools were used significantly, please add the `ai-assisted` label to this PR.
